player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aikin dole ne a ɓoye [macro micro] tare da lambobi 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Indeesji fu haani laato hakkunde 0 be 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row, mala col wala nder dabare.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Fijoowo on haani fija nder micro board je ɗon ɓaawo.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: The micro board is already won.

next_board.any: kala micro board je ɗon mari masinji
next_board.specific: micro board {nxt} ha nder ɓernde ma'ako.

game_action.played: Ɗan {player_id} yaɓɓi a ɓoardiŋo karami {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (row {row}, kolom {col}). Ɗan {opponent_id} inaɓe yaɓɓi a {nxt_txt}.
